split_rule: refine-judge-split/1: a whitespace-normalised predicate text goes to bucket int(sha256('refine-judge-split/1|' + text)[:8], 16) % 10; buckets 0 and 1 are held out (split heldout-predicate, role heldout), so every row of a predicate has one split.
